Select distinct molecule ChEMBL identifiers and canonical SMILES for compounds tested in assays against human histone deacetylase 1. Join molecule_dictionary to activities on molregno, then to assays on assay_id, then to target_dictionary on tid. Filter target_dictionary.pref_name to 'histone deacetylase 1' and target_dictionary.organism to 'Homo sapiens'. Require compound_structures joined as an INNER JOIN to ensure canonical SMILES are present. Sort results by compound ChEMBL identifier.
